history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young East Asian man with dark, neatly styled hair and expressive brown eyes is captured in a medium close-up shot. He is wearing a simple white t-shirt, a silver chain necklace, two silver rings on his right hand, and a thick silver chain bracelet on his left wrist. He is holding a clear glass filled with a dark beverage, likely iced coffee, and sipping it through a black straw. His gaze is directed towards the viewer with a gentle, inviting expression.

The background features a window with a woven bamboo blind partially obscuring the view. Through the window, traditional East Asian architecture is visible, characterized by grey tiled roofs and walls constructed from rough, grey bricks. The lighting is soft and natural, coming from the window, creating subtle highlights on the man's face and the glass. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of grey, white, and the deep brown of the drink, creating a serene and relaxed atmosphere. The overall mood is casual, contemplative, and subtly stylish. The image has a clean, high-quality photographic aesthetic.
